column1: # Distribution presets: the kernel and glibc a release ships, and an image for
# runtime tests. A preset is an alias for a generic kernel profile plus
# metadata; it adds no seccomp logic of its own.
# kernel:    mainline major.minor of the release's GA kernel (the oldest kernel
#            a supported install can run). From vendor release notes; a
#            container cannot report it because it shares the host kernel.
# backports: comma-separated syscalls the vendor kernel provides beyond its
#            mainline base, or "-". Empty is the conservative default: an
#            unlisted backport makes the profile stricter than the real kernel,
# status:    image-checked = glibc read from the image with `ldd --version`
#            on 2026-10-10 (all 28 presets); reference = not yet checked.
